analysis: Rapamycin, also known as sirolimus, is an immunosuppressant that primarily works by inhibiting the mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway. This inhibition leads to the blockage of T lymphocyte proliferation by preventing cell cycle progression from the G1 to the S phase. It does not directly inhibit IL-2 transcription, nucleotide synthesis, or costimulatory pathways.
